import sys
from functools import lru_cache
def comps(t,n):
    if n==1: yield (t,); return
    for i in range(t+1):
        for r in comps(t-i,n-1): yield (i,)+r
def solv(n):
    @lru_cache(None)
    def f(c):
        if sum(1 for x in c if x)<=1: return True
        for i in range(n):
            if c[i]>=2:
                l=list(c); l[i]-=2; l[(i+1)%n]+=1
                if f(tuple(l)): return True
        return False
    return f
for n in range(2,7):
    f=solv(n); last=0
    for t in range(2,40):
        if any(not f(c) for c in comps(t,n)): last=t
    print(n,last+1)
